title: Acana Hanging Moth Killer 4 Pack for Wardrobes - Max Performance - Kills in 24 to 48 Hours - Protects Clothing & Bedding
bullet_points: HANGING MOTH KILLER. Safely kill moths, eggs and larvae in 24 - 48 hours. Hung conveniently amongst clothing in your wardrobes
AUTOMATIC END OF LIFE INDICATOR. Replace product when membrane is visibily empty. Lasts up to 3 months dependent on airflow & temperature
PACK CONTENTS: Set of 4 odourless hanging moth killers designed for effective moth control in wardrobes and storage spaces
PRACTICAL DESIGN: Purple-coloured units that blend seamlessly into wardrobe spaces whilst providing lasting protection against moths
description: Keep your clothes and fabrics protected with the Acana Max Hanging Moth Killer. This convenient 4-pack of odourless moth killers offers an effective solution for safeguarding your wardrobe. Each unit is compact enough to hang discreetly in wardrobes, closets, or storage spaces. The purple-coloured units require no assembly, batteries, or power source, making them incredibly simple to use. They have a visible end of life indicator (replace once empty) and will typically last 3 months, dependent on airflow. Perfect for long-term storage protection, these moth killers are designed to defend your precious garments, textiles, and soft furnishings from moth damage. The durable construction ensures reliable performance, while the hanging design allows for optimal placement within your storage spaces. Ideal for use in wardrobes, storage boxes, and clothing bags, these moth killers help maintain the quality of your valued possessions.
